ultra-regenerating mask with nourishing butters and almond oil

93% ingredients of natural origin

Concentrated, nourishing mask. Intensely moisturises and firms the skin. Improves elasticity and smoothness.

How to use

Apply the mask on skin, avoid eye area. Perform a gentle massage, do not rinse. May be used as home care.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Canola Oil, Octyldodecanol, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Hydrogenated Coco-Glycerides, Cetyl Alcohol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Dimethicone, Propylene Glycol, Sodium Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Isohexadecane, Polysorbate 80, Theobroma Cacao (Cocoa) Seed Butter, Panthenol, Pentylene Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Hydroxyacetophenone, Parfum (Fragrance), Acetyl Cedrene, Geraniol, Linalyl Acetate, Linalool, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Citric Acid.

The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2025-05.

MAIN INGREDIENTS

canola oil, cocoa butter, coco-glycerides, shea butter, vegetable glycerin, sweet almond oil
